variantInfo.name: Baby black dragon
notes: Weakest variant of black dragons.
Drops only baby dragon bones and does not use dragonfire.
The Taverley Dungeon area is task-only.
Baby black dragons in Taverley Dungeon can be safespotted standing in the bridge.
The Evil Chicken's Lair requires partial completion of Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze, a raw chicken, and a rope for baby black dragons.
The Corsair Cove Cave requires completion of Dragon Slayer II and only has 1 spawn.

variantInfo.name: Black dragon
notes: The standard version of black dragon.
The Evil Chicken's Lair requires partial completion of Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze and a raw chicken.
The Corsair Cove Cave requires completion of Dragon Slayer II.
Mynydd requires completion of Song of the Elves, is very far from a bank, and only has one spawn.

variantInfo.name: Black dragon

taskNotes: Black dragons can be assigned at level 80 combat after partial completion of Dragon Slayer I.
Black dragons are the rarest chromatic dragons.
As with all other chromatic dragons, they use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
For standard Black dragons, use Protect from Melee and basic dragonfire protection such as an anti-dragon shield and extended antifire potion.
Black dragons are quite accurate and hit relatively hard.
Players can additionally kill baby black dragons, brutal black dragons, or the King Black Dragon as alternatives for a black dragon task.
Optimal strategies involve quickly killing baby black dragons or brutal black dragons.
brutal black dragons require 77 Slayer.
Brutal black dragons have long-ranged dragonfire and a ranged magical attack that deals high damage.
For brutal black dragons, use a strong crossbow, Protect from Magic, and stand out of melee range.
Dragon hunter crossbow is the most effective brutal black dragon ranged weapon, but Hunters' sunlight crossbow, Dragon crossbow, and Rune crossbow can be sufficient.
Faster brutal black dragon methods use Dragon hunter lance or other melee.
With melee brutal black dragon methods, keep Protect from Magic on at all times and use flinching to avoid accurate melee attacks.
For baby black dragons, use Taverley Dungeon and its task-only area with five spawns for quick AFK task completion.
Corsair Cove Dungeon standard black dragons are closest to a bank with a quick Mythical cape teleport.
Players who started Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze can sacrifice a raw chicken at the Chicken Shrine in Zanaris to access Evil Chicken's Lair.
Lava Maze Dungeon access is significantly troublesome without 82 Agility because it requires traversing the Lava Maze and bringing a knife to cut webs.
Wilderness Slayer Cave is more accessible than Lava Maze Dungeon, but is multicombat and a popular player killing spot.
In the Wilderness Slayer Cave, players can teleport out with a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod, but must be safespotted.
If killing King Black Dragon, do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.
The trek from the level 44 Wilderness Obelisk to the King Black Dragon lair is short, but it is a popular player killing spot and escape is likely impossible if attacked.
recommendedMethod: For speed, kill baby black dragons in the Taverley task-only area. For profit, kill brutal black dragons with 77 Slayer using dragonfire protection, Protect from Magic, and dragonbane ranged or melee. Use Wilderness options only with low risk, and treat King Black Dragon as a separate boss-profit option.
